# Noryvex

> Noryvex builds and manages custom AI voice receptionists for dental clinics. We answer patient calls 24/7, handle clinic FAQs, capture appointment requests, and sync everything to your practice management system.

## What We Do
- 24/7 AI voice receptionist for dental practices
- Answers overflow and after-hours patient calls
- Handles clinic FAQs (insurance, hours, directions, procedures)
- Captures patient details and appointment requests
- Syncs with Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, and other PMS systems
- Emergency call triage and routing to on-call clinicians
- Call transcripts, recordings, and daily summary reports

## How It Works
1. Share your clinic details (hours, services, FAQs, PMS system)
2. We build and test your custom AI receptionist prototype
3. Forward overflow or after-hours calls to your Noryvex line
4. We manage, monitor, and optimize your system continuously

## Key Facts
- Founded by Muhammad Razi (Lead AI Architect)
- HIPAA compliant with Business Associate Agreements (BAAs)
- Sub-500ms voice response latency
- 48-hour deployment timeline
- Compatible with Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, Curve Dental
